rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a well-expanded/hatching blastocyst with visible compact ICM and thinned zona; appropriately notes image softness. Slight overconfidence on TE being A-grade from this single partial-focus image prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, prior failed cycle, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about morphology versus euploidy and fresh-cycle PCOS effects. Probability range is plausible, though somewhat optimistic and broad.

Generally aligns well with Gardner grading interpretation, SET preference in a young patient with an excellent blastocyst, and evidence-based IVF practice. Minor limitation is somewhat assertive implantation estimates and a few speculative points without cycle-specific data.

Provides clear, practical recommendations for current transfer management and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, fresh-transfer considerations, uterine/endocrine review, and when to consider further testing.
